capabilities: Open absolute file or folder paths from the clipboard
Resolve paths in the current vault and other registered vaults
Reveal opened files and folders in the file explorer
Open a folder note matching a parent folder
Install or update the plugin across selected vaults
extras: Desktop-only (requires Electron and Node.js APIs for clipboard and filesystem access); documents its privacy behavior and warns to close destination vault windows before syncing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in command to open or reveal a file or folder from an absolute path, including paths in vaults other than the current one.
summary: Opens files and folders from absolute paths copied to the clipboard, resolving them in the current vault or other registered vaults.
